data.one_liner: Widget that emits confetti particles with customizable physics
data.what_it_does: ConfettiWidget renders animated confetti particles on the screen. The ConfettiController controls the emission timing and lifecycle.
use_when: Add visual flair to UI interactions
avoid_when: Use with very high particle counts on low-end devices
Rely on it for critical UI flows where performance is paramount
strengths: Easy to integrate via a single widget
Performance optimizations for 120Hz and low frame rates
weaknesses: Can impact performance if many particles are emitted
No built‑in platform‑specific features like permissions
